channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Lachtal in December: a Styrian family budget, with honest snow odds
item.description: Lachtal December skiing: day pass EUR 62, children up to 6 free, 46 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, but a clear downward trend.

item.title: Saariselkä snow report: 4 cm at the village station, more on the way (14 November 2026)
item.description: Saariselkä snow report for mid-November 2026: the weather station in Saariselkä measured 4 cm on 13 November, steady for a week; about 22 cm is forecast in seven days with no rain; slopes aim to open 21 November.

item.title: White Pass in December: how to book a $69 ski day with real snow odds
item.description: White Pass online tickets start at $69 off-peak and $89 on peak days, and mid-mountain had 20 in (50 cm) of snow on 15 December in 87 % of past winters.

item.title: 58 EUR for a day in the southern sun at Vars-Risoul
item.description: Ski the 131 km of runs in the Forêt Blanche this December with a six-day pass for 298 EUR.

item.title: Riksgränsen and Björkliden snow report: 9 cm at the border, a long wait for the lifts (14 November 2026)
item.description: Riksgränsen and Björkliden snow report for mid-November 2026: the station at Katterjåkk measured 9 cm and Abisko 2 cm on 13 November, the week ahead, why the lifts open only in February, and 46 past winters.

item.title: Ruka in December: a EUR 265 ski week, and which week to pick
item.description: Ruka December skiing: 6-day pass EUR 265, day EUR 58; 36 cm on a typical 15 December, but only 39 % of winters with 30 cm in the first week.

item.title: Monterosa Ski in December: from 40 EUR a day, if you ski high
item.description: Monterosa Ski day passes run from 40.00 to 71.00 EUR online. In December the snow is up high: 124 cm usual at 3030 m, 6 cm at 1207 m.

item.title: Hafjell snow report: a dusting on top, green at Øyer (14 November 2026)
item.description: Hafjell snow report for mid-November 2026: about 2 cm near the top and nothing at the bottom on Norway's national snow map, 9 cm forecast at the top this week with rain below, and how 46 past winters usually look in late November.

item.title: Wolf Creek in December: Colorado's snowiest budget ticket, day by day
item.description: Wolf Creek adult tickets are $96 on regular days and $110 on peak days for 2026-2027; mid-mountain had 34 in (87 cm) of snow on a typical 15 December.

item.title: Fellhorn/Kanzelwand in December: Oberstdorf's top holds, its bottom often not
item.description: Fellhorn/Kanzelwand December skiing: 63 cm at the 1965 m top on a typical 15 December, 10 cm at the bottom; Advent 6-day pass EUR 344.50 until 20 December.

item.title: Why Oslo, Stockholm and Helsinki have no snow while the fjells are white (November 2026)
item.description: On 13 November 2026 the weather stations in Stockholm and Helsinki measured 0 cm of snow while Sälen had 45 cm and Umeå 20 cm. Height, the sea, the city and the track of the storms explain it, with numbers from 46 past winters.

item.title: Les Orres in December: Which Week Gives You the Best Value?
item.description: Plan your December 2026 trip to Les Orres by matching weekly pass prices with our snow history of 46 past winters.

item.title: Hemavan in December: Sweden's deepest early snow, far from the crowds
item.description: Hemavan December skiing: 82 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, every winter with 30 cm there in mid-December; the deepest December of our Nordic set.

item.title: Pyhä and Luosto snow depth: 0 to 9 cm around the fells, a snowy week ahead (14 November 2026)
item.description: Pyhä-Luosto snow depth in mid-November 2026: weather stations around the fells measured 0 to 9 cm on 13 November, below normal; about 23 cm is forecast this week with no rain. Opening plans and 46 past winters.

item.title: Brighton, Utah in December: canyon snow from a $72 ticket
item.description: Brighton day tickets start at $72 for 2026/27 if bought early. Mid-mountain usually has 37 in (94 cm) of snow on 15 December, against 25 in (64 cm) at Park City.

item.title: Pyrenees in December: Grandvalira and Spanish Resorts Compared
item.description: Compare Grandvalira and Spanish resorts in December 2026 for snow depths, lift heights, and prices starting from 49.00 EUR.

item.title: Vemdalen snow conditions: first real snow in the valley, 6 to 12 cm (14 November 2026)
item.description: Vemdalen snow conditions in mid-November 2026: Swedish weather stations around Vemdalsskalet and Björnrike measured 6 to 12 cm on 13 November after a snowy two days, about 8 cm more this week, opening plans and 46 past winters.

item.title: Pitztal Glacier in December: the high one that did not lose its snow
item.description: Pitztal Glacier December skiing: 87 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, December snow up since the 1980s; day pass EUR 77, 6 days EUR 410.

item.title: Voss Resort snow forecast: rain in the valley, up to 35 cm on top this week (14 November 2026)
item.description: Voss snow forecast for mid-November 2026: Norway's national snow map shows about 20 cm at 1348 m and almost nothing in town, our forecast gives about 35 cm on top of Voss Resort over seven days with rain below about 600 m, plus 46 past winters.

item.title: Cheapest snow-sure US ski areas for December 2026: 16 compared
item.description: 16 budget-friendly US ski areas ranked by December snow odds from 46 past winters, with the day prices we checked: from $49 weekdays to $125 and up.

item.title: Astún-Candanchú in December: which week has the best snow?
item.description: For a low-cost December family ski week at Astún-Candanchú, aim for late December when top slopes hold good snow in 67 % of past winters.

item.title: German ski areas in December: which ones actually hold snow
item.description: Germany in December: the Zugspitze and the Fellhorn top had 30 cm in at least 9 of 10 winters in mid-December; Sudelfeld, Brauneck and the Feldberg rarely do.

item.title: Dog sledding in Tromsø this winter: husky farms, season, prices and your own dog in the snow (2026)
item.description: A practical guide to dog sledding around Tromsø in winter 2026-27: which husky farms the tourist board lists, when the snow season starts, what a ride costs, the polar night, and the rules for walking your own dog on snow and near reindeer.

item.title: 44 EUR day passes and December snow at Puy-Saint-Vincent
item.description: Puy-Saint-Vincent pairs a 44 EUR adult 1-day pass with solid December snow higher up, compared here with its big neighbour Serre Chevalier.

item.title: Kläppen snow depth: Sälen station jumped to 45 cm overnight, but mild air is coming (14 November 2026)
item.description: Kläppen snow depth in mid-November 2026: the weather station in Sälen, 13 km away, measured 45 cm on 13 November after 11 cm the day before; the resort reports 25 cm. Rain risk this week, opening 11 December, 46 past winters.

item.title: Grand Targhee in December: near-certain snow, if you pick the date
item.description: Every one of our 46 past winters had 20 in (50 cm) or more at Grand Targhee's mid-mountain on 15 December. Online day tickets run $125 to $180 by date.

item.title: Oppdal in December: Norway's surest early snow that few foreigners know
item.description: Oppdal December skiing: 60 cm at the 585 m base on a typical 15 December, 93 % of winters with 30 cm there in mid-December, better than Trysil's base.

item.title: Grimentz-Zinal in December: High Snow and Old Village Charm
item.description: Grimentz-Zinal offers 71 km of runs and reliable high-altitude snow for your December trip, with 6-day passes at CHF 339.00.

item.title: Cheapest ski weeks in Austria before Christmas: 11 resorts, snow vs price
item.description: Austria before Christmas: Galtür EUR 258 and Kühtai EUR 269 for 6 days with 30 cm in over 90 % of winters; glaciers cost more, small hills are a gamble.

item.title: Baqueira Beret in December: Snow Facts and Prices for Your Trip
item.description: Planning a December trip to Baqueira Beret? See our snow history, ticket prices starting at 70,00 € for a 1-day pass, and how it compares to Astún-Candanchú.

item.title: Bergen with your dog this weekend: rain, not snow, and the leash rules that apply all year (14 November 2026)
item.description: Bergen dog owners, weekend of 14 November 2026: bare ground at Florida on Friday, 5 cm only up at Kvamskogen, and a very wet Sunday. Bergen's year-round leash rules, the four fenced dog yards, and the Fløyen trails.

item.title: Snow in Bergen? Bare ground in town, 5 cm at Kvamskogen, and a very wet Sunday (13 November 2026)
item.description: Bergen on 13 November 2026: bare ground at the Florida station in town, 5 cm at Kvamskogen at 455 m, 10 cm at Mjølfjell. Snow in town in mid-November is rare, and this weekend brings rain, up to about 40 mm on Sunday.

item.title: Ranked: French Resorts for December Snow and Low Pass Costs
item.description: We rank French ski resorts by December snow odds and checked pass prices, starting from 36.00 EUR for an adult day pass in Les Karellis.

item.title: Is December too early to ski in the High Atlas?
item.description: At Oukaïmeden, December gives 18 cm at mid-mountain in a typical month, against 44 cm in February and 53 cm in March. What 46 winters say about the right month to ski.

item.title: Free peak finder app: name every mountain you see, tested
item.description: SnowScope's peak finder is a free peak finder app: point your phone at the mountains and it names the summits, with height, distance and climb time. Our tests: 98 % of the summits it lists are really in sight, and on real photos it corrected compass errors of up to 105° to 0.15°. Free with 3 names, every peak for $0.99 once.

item.title: Galtür in December: the quiet Paznaun option with a low-season price
item.description: Galtür December skiing: 55 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, 93 % of winters with 30 cm in mid-December; low-season day pass EUR 55.50 until 18 December.

item.title: Geilo in December: steady family snow and a day pass from NOK 590
item.description: Geilo December skiing: 57 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December, 96 % of winters with 30 cm in mid-December; day passes from NOK 590 (about EUR 56).

item.title: Dog walks in Göteborg this weekend: no snow, but November rules give you room (14 November 2026)
item.description: Göteborg dog owners, weekend of 14 November 2026: 0 cm of snow measured around the city on Friday, a mild, mostly dry weekend. Where the leash rules are relaxed in November, the 12 fenced dog yards and Delsjöområdet.

item.title: Snow in Göteborg? Bare in the city, one white surprise to the north-east (13 November 2026)
item.description: Göteborg on 13 November 2026: 0 cm at Askim, Kållered, Härryda and every station near the city. One station 39 km to the north-east, Gunntorp, reported 12 cm. A mild weekend, rain on Monday.

item.title: Is Grandvalira Worth Skiing in December on a Budget?
item.description: Grandvalira is often sold as cheap December skiing, yet natural snow at the base averages just 9 cm in past winters.

item.title: Dog weekend in Helsinki: no snow yet, so here are the dog forest, the parks and the rules (14 November 2026)
item.description: Helsinki for dog owners this weekend: 0 cm of snow measured at all five city stations on Friday. The Östersundom dog forest, nearly a hundred dog parks, the rules on ski tracks, and a grey, mild weekend.

item.title: Hemsedal in December: the steep valley where height decides everything
item.description: Hemsedal December skiing: 70 cm mid-mountain and 106 cm at the top on a typical 15 December, but 32 cm at the base; Geilo nearby from NOK 590 a day.

item.title: Hintertux Glacier in December: where the value is in a sure-snow week
item.description: Hintertux Glacier December skiing: 98 cm at 3245 m and 52 cm mid-mountain on a typical 15 December; day pass EUR 82, 6 days EUR 399, small children free.

item.title: Which Italian ski resorts give the best value in December?
item.description: Compare December snow odds and checked lift pass prices starting at 40.00 EUR across Italian ski areas for your weekend drive.

item.title: Kühtai in December: Austria's high budget week near Innsbruck
item.description: Kühtai December skiing: 60 cm at the 1939 m base on a typical 15 December, and a low-season 6-day pass of EUR 269 until 18 December.

item.title: Les 2 Alpes in December 2026: Why the 3511 m top saves the trip
item.description: Les 2 Alpes reaches 3511 m for high snow in December 2026, with an adult 6-day pass priced at 266.50 EUR.

item.title: Les Karellis in December: Small resort with big snow for families
item.description: Les Karellis offers 45 km of runs and a 6-day adult pass for 191.00 EUR with a 98 % chance of snow mid-mountain in late December.

item.title: Levi in December: polar-night skiing, steady snow, EUR 57 to 60 a day
item.description: Levi December skiing: 38 cm on a typical 15 December, 91 % of winters with 30 cm in Christmas week, and December snow up, not down; day pass EUR 60, EUR 57 online.

item.title: 51.50 EUR for early December skiing in high-altitude Livigno
item.description: Ski Livigno for 51.50 EUR per day before December 18 when the snow at the top reaches 30cm in 100 % of past winters.

item.title: Luleå snow depth: no airport reading, 3 to 7 cm all around (13 November 2026)
item.description: Luleå on 13 November 2026: the Kallax airport station sent no snow depth today, but the stations around the city measured 3 to 7 cm, all new since Thursday, with more snow falling on Friday.
